svg.title: URTC-DOCS architecture
svg.desc: URTC-DOCS holds the architecture, interface, security and capability documents of URTC and the tools that read the manifests, READMEs and changelogs of the other repositories to write the catalogue, the At a glance tables and the brand, to check the claims and the shared files, and to run the nightly comparison. Everything is tested on a computer; no hardware is involved.
